title: A Pascal-type construction of the Segre cubic and the Cremona--Richmond configuration
summary: We present a Pascal-type residual construction in P^4. Starting from two quadruples of hyperplanes whose four diagonal intersection planes lie in a hyperplane, we show that the twelve residual planes lie on a cubic threefold. In the general case this cubic is the Segre cubic, and the construction recovers its fifteen planes and the associated Cremona--Richmond configuration. We also exhibit a point-line realization of this configuration in P^4 and show that it gives a (5,3)-geprofi set.
